chunks: Abu Basir narrated from Abu Abdullah عليه السلام, who said:
"The boundary of what the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله declared sacred from al-Madinah is from Rabab to Waqim, and al-'Urayd and al-Naqb on the side of Makkah."

key_terms.النَّقْبِ: a boundary landmark on the side of Makkah
key_terms.الْعُرَيْضِ: a boundary landmark mentioned in the hadith
key_terms.الْمَدِينَةِ: the city of al-Madinah whose sacred boundary is being described
key_terms.حَدُّ: the boundary or limit being defined
key_terms.رَبَابٍ: a boundary landmark mentioned in the hadith
key_terms.رَسُولُ اللَّهِ: the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله, who established this sanctity
key_terms.وَاقِمٍ: a boundary landmark mentioned in the hadith

ai.seo_question: What are the sacred boundaries of al-Madinah according to a hadith from Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith defines the boundary of the sacred precinct established by the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله around al-Madinah. Its significance is legal and historical, as it identifies the limits of an area given special sanctity in the Prophetic sunnah (prophetic tradition).
